definition: what a belief change of mine requires before it will seat

settled:
The behavior I start from has to be named at high resolution. Everything downstream attaches to it, and attached to something vague the new belief cannot seat. I have restarted a dig at the first step and asked for five to ten times the specificity.

That looks like perfectionism and is the opposite of it. Perfectionism is a threat reflex guarding against a bad output. This is building the only ground the change can hold on.

Most people can change a belief on a felt shift they never put into words. I cannot, because the feeling only opens through the understanding.

A true belief is harder to replace than a false one. There is nothing to refute, only a costly true account to re-compress into one that explains the same evidence for less.

The run is fast and the build is not. A whole dig has gone end to end in a day, after months of pressure gathering behind it.

title: What A Dig Needs To Take Hold
